en: A black‑and‑white image showing a very long, two‑storey institutional building with a low, hipped roof and regularly spaced rectangular windows. A slightly taller central section with decorative window surrounds and an arched entrance suggests the main portal. The building is fronted by a line of trees and a simple fence, beyond which lies a large open field of grass or stubble. The sky is blank and bright, and the photo edges show slight damage or vignetting typical of early 20th‑century prints. No text is visible on the image.
